name: Enli Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Enli Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in providing sophisticated testing solutions exclusively for the optical sensor market. Their extensive services cover detailed evaluations for image sensors, including those utilized in fingerprint-on-display technology, alongside precise testing for photo detectors and the analysis of photon-electron conversion efficiency (EQE). Furthermore, the company offers a range of products, such as both standard and custom-designed light simulators, specialized measurement tools like full-spectrum irradiance meters, and the necessary software to operate these systems. Founded in 2009, Enli Technology maintains its headquarters in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
